description: This file defines the CursorOption interface, which extends the Option interface, representing a cursor-based query resumption option in a paging or iteration context.

classes.name: CursorOption
classes.description: An interface representing a cursor option for resuming previous queries, providing methods to get cursor string and its string representation.

methods.name: getCursor
methods.description: Returns the page size or cursor string used to resume a query.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides the string representation of the cursor option, formatted as "size(<value>)".
